story.title: Man with a gun and knife is fatally shot by security at Nashville federal courthouse, police say - NBC News

facts.text: A man armed with a pistol and knife was fatally shot by a security officer Thursday just inside the busy entrance of a federal courthouse in Tennessee’s largest city, authorities said.
The man in his 40s tried to fire his gun but failed and then pulled out a knife at around 9:30 a.m., said Don Aaron, spokesperson for Metro Nashville Police.
Courthouse visitors must go through a security checkpoint, which is common at all federal courts.
NASHVILLE, Tenn. (WSMV) - Security fatally shot a suspect Thursday morning at a federal courthouse in downtown Nashville, according to authorities.

7:32 p.m. - The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation has released the name of the man who was fatally shot by a security guard after pulling out a gun and knife at the Fred D Thompson Federal Building & Courthouse on Thursday.
10:20 a.m. - WSMV crews share photos from outside the courthouse.
Police have put up crime scene tape and cordoned off the area.
10:46 a.m. - Police say the suspect “has ties to Nashville,” but they did not elaborate on the exact link.
“This is the first time anything like this has happened at this courthouse,” the police spokesperson said.
10:14 a.m. - The Metro Nashville Police Department says that because the shooting happened on federal property, federal authorities will be in charge of investigating.
He then pulled out a knife, and that’s when security discharged their firearm, officials said in a press conference.
NASHVILLE, Tenn. ( WSMV /Gray News) - A man armed with a pistol was shot and killed by security at the federal courthouse in Nashville, Tennessee, according to police.
Nashville Metro Police responded to a “reported shooting call” at the Fred D.
Thompson Federal Building and Courthouse Thursday morning.
He then pulled out a knife and was subsequently shot by a courthouse security officer.
The suspect’s identity has not been released.
Police did say the man is in his 40s and is from out of state but “has ties to Nashville.” They did not elaborate on the exact connection.
“This is the first time anything like this has happened at this courthouse,” the police spokesperson said.
A man was fatally shot Thursday morning after pulling out a gun at a federal courthouse in Nashville.
Nashville police say security officers shot the suspect outside the building.
Officials say he then pulled out a knife, at which point security officers discharged their firearms.
